examples.text_en: They talk about the augmentation of the army.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论着军队的扩充。

examples.text_en: The clear sky was a good augury for the trip.
examples.text_zh: 晴朗的天空是这次旅行的好预兆。

examples.text_en: They saw an augury in the flight of birds.
examples.text_zh: 他们从鸟的飞行中看出了预兆。

examples.text_en: The aural test was hard for the children.
examples.text_zh: 这项听觉测试对孩子们来说很难。

examples.text_en: He has an aural problem in one side.
examples.text_zh: 他的一侧耳朵有听觉问题。

examples.text_en: A bright aureole surrounded the head of the saint.
examples.text_zh: 一圈明亮的光环围绕着圣人的头部。

examples.text_en: The moon had a pale aureole that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天夜里，月亮带着一圈淡淡的光环。

examples.text_en: He will tell me the news in an auricular way.
examples.text_zh: 他会用耳语般的方式告诉我这个消息。

examples.text_en: The auricular part of it is quite small.
examples.text_zh: 它耳状的那部分相当小。

examples.text_en: That was a good auspice for the new work.
examples.text_zh: 那对新工作来说是个好兆头。

examples.text_en: They saw an auspice in the morning light.
examples.text_zh: 他们在晨光中看到了一个吉兆。

examples.text_en: The game was under the auspices of the school.
examples.text_zh: 这场比赛由学校主办。

examples.text_en: The group works under the auspices of the city.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体在市政府的支持下运作。

examples.text_en: It was an auspicious day for the wedding.
examples.text_zh: 那是举行婚礼的吉日。

examples.text_en: The team made an auspicious start this season.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍本赛季开局良好。

examples.text_en: The family will live in great austerity.
examples.text_zh: 这家人将过着极其简朴的生活。

examples.text_en: The government will ask for austerity that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年政府将要求实行紧缩。

examples.text_en: Experts will authenticate the painting before the sale.
examples.text_zh: 专家会在出售前鉴定这幅画的真伪。

examples.text_en: The bank must authenticate each signature on the form.
examples.text_zh: 银行必须核实表格上的每个签名。
